_comment_20260818_isolated_mr_rate_high_: Cloned from .20260817.0N with one change (see AGENTS.md's 20260818 entry for the full analysis/rationale): mr_rate_high 8.0 -> 5.0. This is a deliberately isolated retest of the .20260815.pilot_mr{5,6,8} finding (mr_rate_high=8 nearly doubled gene_mean_mean/gene_var_mean match over 3 seeds/80 trials with max_lib_size_zero_frac held at the old 0.05 baseline) which did NOT replicate in the full .20260815.0{0-7} sweep -- but that sweep confounded the mr_rate_high change with a simultaneous max_lib_size_zero_frac 0.05->0.10 bump, so it was never a clean A/B. This time, .20260817.0{0-7} (already run, mr_rate_high=8.0, max_lib_size_zero_frac=0.10) serves as the "mr=8" arm directly -- this config is the matching "mr=5" arm at the identical guard value (0.10) and every other setting (weights, search space, n_clusters=15, target v4 pickle), giving a true isolated comparison for the first time. Aim for a comparable ~80-100 completed trials per seed to .20260817 for a clean comparison; same unbounded/graceful-stop pilot workflow, shared PYTHONHASHSEED.
_comment_unbounded_run: n_trials/timeout both null (unbounded) -- this study is meant to be run with the new graceful-stop workflow (see tune_synthetic_data.py's module docstring's 'Interrupting/resuming a run' section): launch all 8 seeds as independent processes and let each run for as long as you want; send SIGINT/SIGTERM to a given process to stop it gracefully once you're satisfied with its progress (or all of them at some shared deadline) -- the in-flight trial finishes normally and the usual tuned_synthetic_config.*.json summary still gets written. Re-running against this same storage/study_name later resumes correctly. This replaces the previous fixed-n_trials=250 design, which left faster-finishing seeds idle while slower ones were still mid-run, and which (per the .20260814 analysis) still showed meaningful late-stage improvement in 5/8 seeds even at 250 trials.
_comment_mr_rate_high_pending_pilot: mr_rate_high bumped 5.0 -> 8.0 based on the .20260815.pilot_mr{5,6,8}.0{0,1,2} pilot (3 seeds x 80 trials each, guard left at the .20260814 baseline 0.05 to isolate this one variable): mr_rate_high=8 nearly doubled gene_mean_mean/gene_var_mean match (ratio-to-target 0.38->0.69 / 0.15->0.28 averaged over 3 seeds, and tightly clustered per-seed 0.68-0.70/0.267-0.287 vs. the noisier mr5/mr6 groups) with no measurable cost to pca_pc2_9_explained_variance_ratio match (flat ~0.64-0.67 across all three mr_rate_high values) -- consistent with the hypothesis that raising the biological MR production ceiling helps gene magnitude without leaning on the lib_size_mean/lib_size_scale knobs that are in real, confirmed tension with PCA structure (see the .20260814 session analysis). Best-trial lib_size_scale also fell 0.83->0.75->0.62 as mr_rate_high rose 5->6->8, consistent with TPE substituting away from that PCA-damaging lever rather than just adding an independent effect. Caveat: only 3 seeds/pilot value -- a real effect, but not a large-sample confirmatory result.

weights._comment_excluded_keys: Explicitly excluded (weight 0.0) rather than merely omitted below: an omitted key still defaults to weight 1.0 in compute_stats_distance, not 0.0 -- these 12 keys were previously omitted by oversight and ended up silently contributing ~25% of the total objective across the 20260811.* studies (see AGENTS.md's Known Issues and compute_stats_distance's own docstring). gene_mean_mean/gene_mean_std/gene_var_mean/gene_var_std were re-added above at weight 1.0 (this config) after the .20260812.* studies showed those four consistently undershooting the target by 2-4x while contributing nothing to the objective; the remaining percentile duplicates (gene_mean_p5/p25/p50/p75/p95, gene_var_p5/p25/p50/p75/p95) and mean_var_log_slope/mean_var_log_corr stay excluded to avoid overweighting the same underlying distribution shape multiple times. Set any of these to a nonzero value if you want to score them too.
